claims.claim: 64-bit ids and precise numbers survive the exact parse/emit path without loss: 1,000/1,000 generated ids spanning 2^40..2^63 and 500/500 decimals with 20 significant digits round-trip byte-exact (int lane via parse_int=int, decimal lane via parse_float=Decimal and a verbatim-digit emitter).

Negative control: a float64-based parser loses ids above 2^53 - 4/6 probed values mis-parsed (e.g. 9007199254740993 -> 9007199254740992) and 2^53 vs 2^53+1 collapse to the same float - proving the exact lane is load-bearing, not a tautology.

negative_controls.description: The known-broken float parse lane (parse_int=float, parse_float=float) mis-parses ids above 2^53; the exact lane returns them bit-exact.

implementation.exact_lane: json.loads(parse_int=int, parse_float=Decimal); emit_exact serializes Decimal digits verbatim via a quoted marker stripped post-dump
implementation.property: generated ids uniform over 2^40..2^63; decimals with exactly 20 significant digits, exponents -8..8

signals.a: string equality of the emitted token with the canonical digit string
